name: El Insuperable
description: Hardware and paint retailer in Montevideo with an online catalogue on the Fenicio platform. States shipping across Uruguay, with free shipping on orders above UYU 2,000 and same-day dispatch.
description_es: Ferretería y pinturería de Montevideo con catálogo online sobre la plataforma Fenicio. Indica envíos a todo el país, gratuitos en compras superiores a UYU 2.000, y despacho el mismo día.

ships_to.notes: Shipping stated nationwide; free on orders above UYU 2,000. Cost below that and interior delivery time not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Lists a Montevideo store address; in-store pickup is not confirmed on the site.
